stem: Which sentence suggests that Junior Achievement students will be well prepared to join the working world?

options.label: A
options.text: In San Francisco a new library opened recently with a preschool program that offers books about money management for children as young as three years old.

options.label: B
options.text: Growing up and entering the "real world" is a challenge everyone must face.

options.label: C
options.text: It is not unusual to see a BizTown student wearing a hard hat and learning about construction or interviewing for a job with actual business owners.

options.label: D
options.text: The program is run largely by volunteers from area businesses and universities, parents, and senior citizens—all of whom believe in the potential of young people.
